source: AI weekly plan for the KW Edge Tech Race. Written every Monday from the KWHomes Analytics Weekly Digest and the KW Homes Race figures.

plans.headline: Mobile visits more than doubled last week. Social shares and leads are the gaps to close this week.

advice.title: Phones are where buyers are
advice.text: KW Edge mobile visits jumped from 184 to 490 last week. Buyers look on their phones, so send the KW Homes link in WhatsApp, not a screenshot, and every view counts for you.

advice.title: Social has gone flat
advice.text: Facebook and Instagram have sent about 35 to 42 visits a week for five weeks. Post one listing this week with its KW Homes link in the post, and put it on your WhatsApp status too.

advice.title: Turn views into enquiries
advice.text: The office had thousands of listing views last week but only three leads. End every listing message with: tap the WhatsApp button on the listing to book a viewing.

advice.title: Today's move
advice.text: Pick your best active listing, share its KW Homes link in two WhatsApp groups and on your status, and ask one past client to forward it.

challenges.name: WhatsApp Tap
challenges.rule: Get 2 or more WhatsApp clicks on your KW Homes listings this week
challenges.tip: In every listing message, ask people to tap the WhatsApp button on the KW Homes page instead of messaging you directly.

challenges.name: vCard Stretch
challenges.tip: Add your vCard link to your WhatsApp status, your email signature and every new contact you save today.

challenges.name: Double Lead
challenges.rule: Get 2 or more KW Homes leads this week
challenges.tip: Share listings with the KW Homes link so the enquiry form is one tap away, and reply to every enquiry within 15 minutes.
